fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for bug request 01M79YDVQC0XXJ652A36ST5BDJ: no owner was asked, so nothing here is quoted. The planner's research found the following. (1) Every multi-minute poll in the daemon journal on 2026-11-13 (3m3s to 7m9s, ten of them between 01:59Z and 07:53Z) ends 5 to 20 s after a 'leftovers sweep freed' line, and no poll near a sweep was short; polls without a sweep stayed under about 55 s. The hourly leftovers sweep (daemonSweepLeftovers, called from the home project's prepare step inside the poll) runs leftovers.Scratch, which calls filepath.Glob('<TMPDIR>/claude-*/*/<session id>') once per recorded session: the rhiza project records 4136 sessions and ~/tmp/claude-1000 holds 2657 folders, so one sweep reads that folder about 4k times and makes about 11M lstat calls, under a load of 10-28. That is the step that blocks for minutes. (2) The four defunct [git] children of rhiza:935303 started at 10:33:36, 13:02:43, 20:54:19 and 23:33:28 on 2026-11-12, each in the same second as a 'binary changed, re-executing' line: git programs still running when the daemon re-executed itself, whose waiting goroutines died with the old image. The driver list reaps only detached run drivers, so nothing waits on them. (3) The daemon's per-project git calls (projectCtx's Git and the home ctx's gitIn) and most ctx.Exec calls in a poll run with no time limit; only the model-branch network work (30 s), the self-update fetch (30 s), hooks (10 s) and the failure classifier (60 s) are bounded. (4) The poll-behind watchdog line says only how long the poll took, and it is written after the poll ends. The planner serves the landed intent m24-on-the-vm, which the earlier daemon CPU fix 01M6H6SGKR served. The decisions below are the planner's, made under autonomy from this research: make the sweep one listing, take housekeeping off the poll, bound each git program a poll runs at 30 s, name the slow steps in the existing log line and watchdog record and add one line while a poll runs over its limit, and have each new daemon image adopt its inherited children onto the driver list.
fields.title: Plan of the slow root daemon poll fix (autonomous plan run)
